# CD Respect

> Club Deportivo Respect is a football (soccer) club based in El Fraile, Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. Founded in 2024. Address: Dionisio Gonzalez, El Fraile, Tenerife. Phone: +34 677 71 14 54. Email: cdrespect.es@gmail.com. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cd_respect. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/cdrespect/

## Pages (Spanish, default)

- [Home](https://poetic-youtiao-dfd1bf.netlify.app/): Club overview, founding info, location, and the three programs: Juvenil (youth academy, alevin to juvenil age groups), Primer equipo (adult senior team), and Academia internacional (international academy open to players and families based in Tenerife).
- [Cantera](https://poetic-youtiao-dfd1bf.netlify.app/cantera/): Youth academy detail page. The alevin team was champion of the Liga Alevin Preferente 2025-2026 season. Photo gallery and Instagram link.
- [Privacidad](https://poetic-youtiao-dfd1bf.netlify.app/privacidad/): Privacy and cookie policy.

## Pages (English)

- [Home](https://poetic-youtiao-dfd1bf.netlify.app/en/): Same content as the Spanish home page, in English.
- [Academy](https://poetic-youtiao-dfd1bf.netlify.app/en/youth/): Same content as /cantera/, in English.
- [Privacy](https://poetic-youtiao-dfd1bf.netlify.app/en/privacy/): Same content as /privacidad/, in English.

## Notes

Every page exists in both Spanish (default, at the root paths) and English (under /en/), with hreflang alternate links connecting each pair. A language switcher in the site header links between them. The club's guiding principle is respect: for opponents, referees, teammates, and the shirt. The site sets no tracking cookies; a cookie banner records only the visitor's accept/reject choice in local storage.
